versions.changelog:
- Added workflow for users without an API key: allows starting website creation via a personalized registration link using a brief (max 250 characters) business description.
- Simplified prompt handling: focus only on the essential business description; no need to specify design, sections, or layout.
- Updated polling interval for status checks to every 1 minute (was 15–20 seconds).
- Live and editor URLs updated to new domains in responses.
- Retry endpoint now also supports sites with "ready" status in addition to "failed" status.
- Documentation streamlined with clearer instructions and improved onboarding for new users.

- API base URL updated from `https://api.web.oto.dev/openapi/api/v1` to `https://api.evoweb.ai/openapi/api/v1`
- Registration and API key instructions now point to https://evoweb.ai instead of a third-party service
- No logic or workflow changes in API usage or assistant instructions
- No file changes detected—documentation update only

- Updated homepage and API registration URLs to use version-neutral UTM parameters (“v1.0”).
- Removed detailed registration process instructions including terms acceptance and email update settings. (Assuming that the bot will NOT perform any actions on behalf of the user - to make sure GDPR compliance)
- No code or endpoint changes; documentation simplification only.

- Updated version identifier (v1.0.7).
- Expanded and clarified the authentication and registration process, including new sections on terms acceptance, privacy policy, and email confirmation requirements.
- Added explicit notes on required and optional fields during account registration, including consent to terms and promotional emails.
- No functional changes to API usage or workflow instructions.

- Updated URLs in the homepage and API key registration links to reflect new tracking parameters, including version, medium, and content tags.
- No changes to functionality, endpoints, or workflow.
- Metadata remains the same except for the homepage link update.
- Documentation updated for version and tracking clarity.

- Updated skill and product name to "EvoWeb.ai AI Website Builder" for improved clarity.
- Enhanced description to highlight 4-minute website creation.
- No functional or API changes were introduced in this version.
- Documentation and branding refreshed for consistency.

- Updated homepage URL to include campaign tracking parameters.
- Changed registration/authentication instructions to use a new registration URL with UTM tags.
- Noted that email confirmation is now required after registration to access the API key.
- No code or API changes; documentation improvements only.

Version 1.0.3

- Updated API key registration instructions for greater clarity.
- Added explicit dashboard directions for locating the API key.
- No changes to functionality or API endpoints.

Version 1.0.2

- Added a new markdown metadata block with skill name, description, homepage, and environment variable requirements.
- Updated the skill description to emphasize compatibility with ChatGPT, Gemini, and modern search platforms.
- No code or functional changes; documentation and metadata enhancements only.
